## Summary / Опис змін / Описание изменений
- [ ] Describe the change and acceptance criteria.
- [ ] Preserve canonical repository, module and API names.

## Weakness → verified capability
- Original limitation and supporting evidence:
- Implemented behavior and acceptance criteria:
- Remaining boundary or trade-off:

## Documentation and UI
- [ ] Root README and affected UA/EN/RU variants are current.
- [ ] UI follows `docs/gui/GUI_DESIGN_STANDARD.md` and existing Duck tokens.
- [ ] Screenshots are from a runnable build; wireframes are labelled concept.
- [ ] No placeholder telemetry, invented metrics or unimplemented claims.

## Verification
- [ ] Relevant unit/integration tests pass.
- [ ] Required CI checks are green; failures are linked and explained.
- [ ] Changed code meets the 80% coverage target where coverage is configured, or an exception is justified.
- [ ] Build, lint, format and API/schema checks pass where configured.
- [ ] Security, privacy, rollback and compatibility reviewed.

## Review policy
- Branches: `feature/<ticket>-<slug>`, `fix/<slug>`, `docs/<slug>`.
- No direct commits to protected `main`/`master`/`release` branches.
- Merge gate: two independent approvals and all required CI checks passing, enforced through repository branch protection.
- [ ] Two independent approvals recorded.
- [ ] All required checks successful.

## Українська / Русский
- [ ] Документація оновлена українською, англійською та російською, якщо ці файли є.
- [ ] Тести, збірка, форматування, безпека та сумісність перевірені.
- [ ] Перед злиттям отримано два незалежні схвалення та успішний CI; правила мають бути ввімкнені в налаштуваннях захисту гілки.
